components.label: Total investments
components.source: Filing accession 0001193125-26-224294, Schedule of Investments, table 22 row 7: TOTAL INVESTMENTS, fair value $2,943,879 (in thousands)

evidence.quote: Total Investments, at fair value (amortized cost of $2,963,987 and $2,883,469, respectively) | 2,943,879 | 2,882,954

rationale: The filing presents a single grand TOTAL INVESTMENTS row for March 31, 2026 with cost of $2,963,987 thousand and fair value of $2,943,879 thousand. This row follows the non-controlled/non-affiliated and controlled/affiliated schedule sections and therefore is the grand total, not a schedule subtotal. The same amount appears on the balance sheet as Total Investments, at fair value and equals the companyfacts investments-at-fair-value tag. It is 96.51% of total assets, leaving a plausible non-investment remainder of $106.464 million.
